title: Happy Birthday ASCII Art: Copy & Paste Cake, Banner & Balloon Text Art
meta_description: Copy and paste happy birthday ASCII art: candle cakes, cupcakes, HAPPY BIRTHDAY banners, balloons and one-line wishes, drawn in plain text with spacing kept.
hero_tagline: Cakes, banners, balloons and one-line wishes drawn in plain text. Click Copy on any card to take it with its line breaks.
intro: Happy birthday ASCII art is a birthday message drawn with keyboard characters instead of pictures: a cake made of pipes and tildes, a banner boxed in plus signs, a bunch of balloons on slash strings. The one-line wishes paste anywhere. The multi-line pieces hold their shape only where every character is the same width, which is true in a Discord code block, a terminal or a plain-text editor such as Notepad, and not true in an Instagram caption or a phone's message app, where the columns drift apart. Every piece below is an original drawing, and the Copy button takes the spaces and line breaks with it.

faq.q: Why does the cake look broken after I paste it?
faq.a: The app is showing it in a proportional font, where an i is narrower than a W, so the columns slide out of line. In Discord, wrap the art in three backticks on the line above and the line below to turn it into a code block, which uses a fixed-width font.

faq.q: Can I put a name on the cake or banner?
faq.a: Yes. Replace the words inside the box and keep the line the same length by adding or removing spaces, so the right-hand edge stays lined up. For a name in big letters, the ASCII art generator linked below turns any word into block letters.

faq.q: Which birthday art works in an Instagram caption or a text message?
faq.a: The one-line wishes. Instagram captions and most phone message apps use proportional fonts, so multi-line pieces lose their shape there.
